INSIDE ZEROROUTER

A choice you
can understand.

01

Read the intent

Your outcome is grouped into writing, summarization, reasoning, coding, or synthesis. You describe the work in your own words.

02

Respect the limits

Only enabled providers that meet your provider preference and estimated budget can be selected. An empty pool means adjusting a constraint.

03

Weigh the trade-offs

A task profile combines illustrative quality, cost and completion time. Your priority changes those weights. Every candidate stays visible.

04

Show the choice

You get a selected model, an explanation and a sample response. In this prototype, routing happens locally and responses are prepared examples.

Built to ask better research questions.

ZeroPrompt is a K³ research proposal comparing U.S. and Chinese LLM APIs. Live adapters, measured profiles and secure server-side keys belong to the next implementation stage. No benchmark results are claimed here.
